C1_no_trade_watchdog.description: Tracks ticks since last order submission and zero-candidate ticks. States: OK → WARNING_NO_TRADES (6hr) → CRITICAL_MULTI_SESSION (12hr). Resets on any order.

C2_equity_fallback_watchdog.description: Counts total equity fallback uses and tracks consecutive fallback streak. WARNING at 10+ consecutive, CRITICAL at 25+. Streak resets when fresh equity obtained.

C3_universe_drift_watchdog.description: Periodic check comparing active universe against configured base. Reports missing symbols, added symbols, and missing protected symbols. WARNING on drift.

C4_brain_save_watchdog.description: Tracks ticks since last successful brain save. Healthy if < 1080 ticks (3hr). WARNING logged if stale.

C5_unified_watchdog_state.description: get_watchdog_state() returns unified dict with all 4 watchdog sections. Exposed in LiveTickResult.to_dict() and engine.status().
